cases.description: The symptom explicitly correlates the failure with this morning's deploy ('worked fine yesterday') and names a specific recent change — the webhook signature verification — as the release-notes item most likely responsible.
cases.grounding: Symptom text: 'started right after the deploy this morning', 'release notes mention a change to the webhook signature verification'.

cases.description: engine/webhook_handler.py's verify_signature function is the primary candidate — it's both the top keyword match (score 14) and the exact function the release notes call out as changed.
cases.grounding: candidates.candidates[0] = {path: engine/webhook_handler.py, score: 14}; module functions include 'verify_signature'.

cases.description: Confirm by diffing verify_signature's implementation against the pre-deploy version (or re-running a known-good webhook payload against both) to see whether the new signature check rejects a payload the old one accepted — a targeted, cheap check before touching payments.py.
cases.grounding: The recent-change correlation makes a before/after diff the highest-leverage confirmation step, not a broad investigation of the whole webhook path.
